title: Venezuelan Chicken Tagine
description: A tender and flavorful Venezuelan dish featuring chicken, raspberries, and tadka spices, cooked to perfection in a ceramic tagine, this crowd-pleaser is a must-try for any occasion, with a rich umami taste that will leave everyone wanting more
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the ceramic tagine over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant
Add the chicken pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes
Add the tadka spice blend and cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant
Add the chicken broth, honey, and raspberries, and stir to combine
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25 minutes
Stir in the chopped cilantro and serve hot over rice or with crusty bread
